FN-AK2WSSQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 133
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 133 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Securities
Commission until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
